name: Net
summary: Thrown at a creature within 15 ft: Dex save or Restrained until it escapes.
text: When you take the Attack action, you can swap one of your attacks for throwing the Net at a creature you can see within 15 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus or has the Restrained condition until it escapes; a Huge or larger target succeeds automatically. The target, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing the target on a success. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees it.
